title: Matching API still over 1 second with 200+ students
text:
v0.3 takes about 4 seconds per matching request with 200+ students. The target is under 1 second.

Follow-up work once the launch traffic is in:

* Cache pairwise free-time overlap instead of recomputing per request
* Add the missing database indexes on course and availability tables
* Re-run the load test and record the numbers

Daniel has a first profile showing most of the time is spent in the overlap calculation.
